verdicts.reason: Quote is at 122-142 as stated. But nothing in the transcript shows shooting on 10th Street: 'let's hit 10th Street real quick' is a plan (functionally the 'we're starting at X' exclusion), the only follow-up is a foot-traffic complaint ('not really enough people are on the Block for this... you put time in but every like 15 minutes or so'), then about 2.5 minutes of interview (146-282) and 'we'll cross this way and then we'll work our way over to City Hall' (284-290), which reads as moving on. No frame, no 'I stood here', the speaker of 'let's hit' is inferred (could be Paulie), the block is never named and 10th Street is a long corridor. Not convinced. Reinstate only if footage 2:02-4:44 shows him shooting on the block.

Quote is at 65-76. The basis is 'we're going to start at City Hall', which is exactly the 'we're starting at X' exclusion, plus 'really standard really basic Street photo boy Philadelphia loop', which describes a generic Philadelphia street-photography route rather than a spot he says he personally returns to. 'hit deal worth [Dilworth] one more time' (86) is today's itinerary and 'hope some hooligans are at Dorth [Dilworth] being bad' (842-844) is an expectation about the place, not a statement of his own regular return. The haunt rule requires the speaker to name it as a regular spot; he never does. Read B was right. The place is still on the map through the shot-here row at 841, so nothing is lost by dropping this.

Quote is at 841-849. They announce the return to City Hall to shoot, and the segment before 'you want to try to go downstairs' (1367-1371) contains shooting: 'help I'm working... my picture was probably better though' (1139-1153), 'it's one critical Focus shot today' (1165-1168), and the worker portrait 'you mind looking up at me cool thanks' (1324-1362). The descent ends on the Broad Street Line platform (1470-1472) after he named City Hall Station as the underground target (849), so the stop before the descent is City Hall. Medium is correct: no line names the spot where those frames were made and the cut is edited, so some of 882-1168 could still be on the walk back from Rittenhouse ('oh I got to cross the street', 1156). 'Dorth' = Dilworth garble is sound. Pin candidate stands only pending footage 14:00-23:00.

The camping ('as I stood here looking') happened at the corner Paulie asks about ten seconds later, 18th & Walnut (679), which already has its own shot-here row for the same person; a second row for the same spot under a corridor name is double counting, and the corridor's extent is never stated. Small and specific beats lumped: keep the corner, drop the corridor.

But no frame is confirmed and he says 'I'm not feeling it right now', so confidence should be medium for the shooting (the location itself is high), and the pin candidate needs footage (~11:05-11:25) to show a frame. Keep as the one exact corner he named on camera.
